chunks: And that God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God being the Lord of Jesus and humanity in Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In the context of Jesus (Isa) speaking from the cradle, this verse establishes his prophetic role and divine authority while affirming the core Islamic tenet of Tawhid. Shia scholarship highlights this as a definitive proof of Jesus' monotheism, counting Christian trinitarian views, and underscores the 'straight path' (Sirat al-Mustaqim) as the adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's guidance. It serves as a bridge between the specific miracle of the cradle speech and the universal call to worship the One Lord.
